about.title: About the shop
about.body: JK Auto Repair is a neighborhood shop in Hamilton Township. The owner started working on cars as a kid and has spent more than 20 years at it. He tells you what your car needs in plain words, in Spanish or English, before he touches anything. Walk in whenever you like, and the estimate costs nothing.

mission.title: What we promise
mission.body: You should leave knowing what we did to your car and why. Honest work at clear prices, with the treatment you would give a neighbor.
